title: Marketo + Folloze: Your Guide to Personalized Campaign Journeys
theme: Marketo + Folloze for Personalized Campaign Journeys
thesis: Marketing teams already using Marketo can accelerate personalized campaign journeys by integrating Folloze. This powerful combination allows one marketer to run programs that traditionally required a team, delivering dynamic content experiences across buying groups. With Marketo + Folloze, expect to launch campaigns 50% faster and achieve clearer pipeline attribution, turning engagement into measurable revenue.
summary: Pipeline anxiety is real for B2B marketing teams. You have the audience segments built in Marketo, the triggers set, and the emails ready. But when a buyer clicks through, they land on a static landing page that does not adapt to their role, industry, or intent. Generic outreach fails to convert informed buyers who already researched your company through AI tools.
key_takeaways: TL;DR: Marketing teams already using Marketo can accelerate personalized campaign journeys by integrating Folloze.
Pipeline anxiety is real for B2B marketing teams.
Marketo plus Folloze is a strategic integration that combines Marketo's marketing automation and audience segmentation with Folloze's AI orchestration platform for dynamic content experiences.
Personalized campaign journeys are essential because buyers now expect relevant, contextual content at every touchpoint.
The traditional campaign model is too slow and dev-dependent to keep pace with modern buyer expectations.
proof_points: With Marketo + Folloze, expect to launch campaigns 50% faster and achieve clearer pipeline attribution, turning engagement into measurable revenue.
With Marketo + Folloze, you gain the ability to launch campaigns 50% faster without adding headcount.
This approach resulted in $10M influenced pipeline for Microsoft, proving the power of a connected journey.
According to Folloze customer Conga (2024), they generated $6.3M attributed pipeline from just six campaigns built on two boards.
